programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Amor Musical
programme.desc: Todo inicia cuando son transferidos a la escuela Jung San que recibe auspicio por parte de una fundación millonaria y poderosa. Como es de esperarse, los días escolares en esta escuela se convierte en una lucha sin fin. Cada día enfrentan el gran abismo entre el rico y el pobre. Ante la cruda realidad, en lo único que pueden confiar es en su música. Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

programme.title: El Gran Vuelo de Nueva Caledonia
programme.desc: The Explorers sobrevolaron Nueva Caledonia, este excepcional territorio francés, para poner de relieve sus excepcionales riquezas naturales y culturales. Esta expedición aérea nos ofrece otra mirada a bosques profundos y milenarios, montañas de vegetación exuberante, islas paradisíacas, una cultura ancestral, una laguna y arrecifes de coral que albergan ecosistemas intactos poblados por una biodiversidad notable.

programme.title: Shadow Boxer

Shadow boxing is an exercise where the athlete boxes with his shadow.

Elena is a student in Minsk making illegal deals in the Chernobyl death zone to save her father from going to prison. She is in an intense but increasingly destructive love affair with Viktor. programme.desc: Des Pyrenees espagnoles ou elle prend sa source, au vaste estuaire de la Gironde ou elle se jette, la Garonne parcourt plus de 600 kilometres a travers le Comminges, l'Agenais ou l'Entre-deux-Mers. Le fleuve evolue au cours de ce long voyage. L'apport de ses affluents, comme la Neste, l'Ariege, le Tarn et le Lot, modifie son visage. A bord d'un helicoptere, Didier Taillefer part en Espagne pour faire des photos aeriennes de l'une des principales sources du fleuve : le Trou du Toro. Ce site exceptionnel est situe au pied du massif de la Maladeta, ou la Garonne disparaît sous terre avant de reapparaître au Val d'Artan. Au coeur des Pyrenees, le fleuve donne naissance a un jardin de Cocagne : le Comminges. Dans le village de Huos, Remy Martin a amenage un verger-potager bio sur un ancien meandre.

programme.title: Encuentros Que Generan Bienestar
programme.desc: Encuentros y conversaciones con personas, proyectos y experiencias que promueven el bienestar y una vida mas consciente. A traves de historias vinculadas al deporte, la naturaleza, la salud y el desarrollo personal, cada episodio invita a descubrir nuevas formas de vivir con equilibrio.

programme.title: Name Me
programme.desc: In sun-bathed Crimea before the Russian invasion, 17-year-old Olya, accompanied by her easygoing friend, Sasha, musters the courage to meet her biological father for the first time. Right before they meet Olya's father, the two decide to switch roles. At first, the whole situation seems to work out well, but soon Sergey, Olya's father, becomes suspicious.

programme.title: El Gran Vuelo de Nueva Caledonia
programme.desc: The Explorers sobrevolaron Nueva Caledonia, este excepcional territorio francés, para poner de relieve sus excepcionales riquezas naturales y culturales. Esta expedición aérea nos ofrece otra mirada a bosques profundos y milenarios, montañas de vegetación exuberante, islas paradisíacas, una cultura ancestral, una laguna y arrecifes de coral que albergan ecosistemas intactos poblados por una biodiversidad notable.

programme.title: Nation Estate
programme.desc: A vertical solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict has been found for the political deadlock in the Middle East. Palestinians have their state in the form of a skyscraper. The building is called the NATION ESTATE. One colossal high-rise houses the entire Palestinian population – who are now finally living 'the high life'.

programme.title: China Reverse
programme.desc: Film director Judith Benedikt embarks on a journey following first and second-generation immigrants from China in Austria, who are mainly stranded in Asian restaurants in the city and in the countryside. After half a century of migration, mainly in one direction, there is a new current flowing back to the East thanks to the economic boom in China.

programme.title: El Gran Inventario del Planeta: Nueva Caledonia, tierra de maravillas terrestres
programme.desc: Con la tripulación de El Explorador, descubra los confines del hemisferio sur, rumbo al archipiélago Austral. El barco atraca en Rairoa, el puerto y pueblo principal de Raivavae. Una vez desembarcado el helicóptero, el equipo se pone en marcha para ofrecer imágenes aéreas del paraíso.

programme.title: 500 Mph Storm - Mega Tornado
programme.desc: Quando viene perso il controllo di un esperimento energetico, una gran quantità di uragani si abbatte sul Nord America. Un insegnante di scienze del liceo cercherà di mettere in salvo la sua famiglia prima dell'arrivo degli uragani, creando un "hypercane", un uragano potente abbastanza da annullare gli altri, ma in grado anche di cancellare gli Stati Uniti dalla faccia della Terra.

programme.title: Metal Tornado
programme.desc: Metal Tornado

programme.title: Flight Of Fear - Terrore Ad Alta Quota
programme.desc: I passeggeri e l'equipaggio di un volo vengono attaccati da forze invisibili che minacciano tutti a bordo, causando panico e caos.

programme.title: Night Of The Wild
programme.desc: In una città apparentemente tranquilla, un meteorite produce un effetto pericoloso sui cani che si trasformano in assassini feroci. Con gli abitanti costretti a difendersi da quelli che un tempo erano gli amici più fedeli, la giovane Roslyn si ritrova a cercare un modo per sopravvivere. Cosa faresti al suo posto?

programme.title: Robotropolis
programme.desc: Androidi all'attacco in un fanta-action inedito! Situata in una isola, una idilliaca comunità è il risultato di un esperimento che ha provveduto a integrare i robot. Infatti, non solo vengono impiegati in qualità di poliziotti ma anche per raccogliere la spazzatura e accompagnare i bambini a scuola. Uno dei maggiori pregi è individuabile nel fatto che non si ribellano mai, almeno fino ad ora.

programme.title: Alienate - Lotta Per La Terra
programme.desc: Ormai alla fine del suo matrimonio, David parte per un viaggio di lavoro per dare alla moglie un po' di spazio. Tuttavia, quando gli aerei cominciano a cadere misteriosamente dal cielo, si ritrova intrappolato in un'invasione aliena.

programme.title: Triassic World
programme.desc: I dinosauri vengono utilizzati per coltivare organi umani per i trapianti. Ma gli scienziati che li hanno creati devono reagire quando le creature scappano.

programme.title: Super Cyclone
programme.desc: Inedito disaster movie firmato The Asylum. Un super ciclone minaccia l'intera costa orientale americana. Una solitaria meteorologa e un ingegnere petrolifero uniranno le loro forze per fermare la catastrofica minaccia naturale. Quella dei due scienziati sarà una corsa contro il tempo, nel tentativo disperato di arrestare la scia di distruzione che sta seminando dietro di sé.

programme.title: Planet Of The Sharks
programme.desc: In un futuro non troppo lontano, lo scioglimento dei ghiacciai ha coperto d'acqua il 98% del pianeta. In questo scenario, gli squali hanno preso il sopravvento guidati da un esemplare geneticamente mutato. I pochi umani sopravvissuti vivono nel terrore ma ben presto un piccolo gruppo di disperati tenterà tutto il possibile per rendere le acque nuovamente sicure.

programme.title: Empire Of The Sharks
programme.desc: Adrenalinico sci-fi scritto e diretto da Mark Atkins (Jurassic School) e sequel di Planet of the Sharks. In un futuro dove il 98% della superficie terrestre è sott’acqua, uno spietato signore della guerra governa grazie al suo esercito di super squali. Solo una ragazza con il potere psichico di comunicare con gli squali tenterà di opporsi, per sconfiggere il tiranno e liberare la sua gente.

programme.title: Sky Sharks
programme.desc: Cyber squali volanti cavalcati da supersoldati mutanti nazisti, attaccano un aereo di linea con l'intento di uccidere i passeggeri. Che la guerra abbia inizio!

programme.title: Ice Sharks
programme.desc: Una nuova razza di squali famelici e aggressivi emerge dai ghiacci di una stazione di ricerca in Antartide, divorando tutti coloro che incontrano sul loro percorso. Per i sopravvissuti della stazione, che sta sprofondando nelle acque gelide, inizierà una lotta per la vita.

programme.title: Attacco Alieno Su Los Angeles
programme.desc: Nel Febbraio del 1942 un oggetto non identificato cade su Los Angeles. Settant'anni dopo gli alieni tornano per completare l'attacco attraverso una grande navicella spaziale atterrata sulla città. Le forze armate di Los Angeles rimangono sconvolte in quanto i loro missili non rispondono più ai comandi. Chi la spunterà?

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Meet China: Starting Green, Reaching the Future
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, wind becomes more than a natural force—it powers a greener future across China and Europe. A piece of fabric reveals how Chinese innovation is reshaping global perceptions of manufacturing. Ancient ruins in central China are reimagined as immersive cultural experiences, turning heritage into living memory. And in Laos, Chinese agricultural expertise is helping farmers unlock higher yields and new opportunities. From energy and textiles to tourism and farming, this episode shows how innovation is renewing tradition and connecting futures across borders.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI talent race and the future of work
programme.desc: As artificial intelligence (AI) transforms industries worldwide, competition in AI is increasingly driven not only by technology, but also by talent, skills and workforce development. In this episode of BizTalk, CGTN's Lily Lyu speaks with industry leaders and universities, to explore how AI is reshaping talent demand across industries, and how China is building a broader AI talent pipeline for the future.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

In this episode of BizTalk, CGTN's Lily Lyu speaks with industry leaders and universities, to explore how AI is reshaping talent demand across industries, and how China is building a broader AI talent pipeline for the future.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Global Business-American Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: Suzhou Fans
programme.desc: Suzhou, known as the “Venice of China,” is also famous for its traditional crafts. And one of the most elegant and exquisite crafts is Suzhou fans. Celebrated for their exquisite design and fine quality, they’re popularly associated with literati. How come Suzhou gave birth to such a variety of fans? How can we appreciate their beauty in the modern world? In this episode, we are discovering more stories behind Suzhou fans.

programme.title: Stitching heritage into the digital future
programme.desc: What if centuries-old craftsmanship could be re-imagined through the lens of new technology? Artist He Wei is doing just that – bringing traditional Chinese embroidery into the digital age through an immersive VR experience. Find out how he preserves cultural heritage and reinterprets folk rituals for a global audience.

programme.title: Discovering the Ancient Grottoes of Chongqing
programme.desc: The third episode of the Chongqing Series, Humanistic Chongqing, focuses on the Dazu Stone Carvings in Chongqing. In 1999, the Dazu Stone Carvings were inscribed on the World Cultural Heritage List. As an outstanding representative of China's late grotto carving art, they integrate the essence of Confucianism, Buddhism and Taoism in their content, fully embodying the beauty of cultural integration. This episode comprehensively showcases the profound historical and cultural heritage of Dazu and its vibrant contemporary folk customs, exploring the thematic connotations, artistic characteristics and historical origins of the Dazu Stone Carvings, as well as their far-reaching influence on the local people for generations.

programme.title: Three Gorges of Chongqing
programme.desc: In this episode, through the new fashion of five-star cruise tour on the Three Gorges, with comfortable and convenient high-end experiences, we take the audience to travel along the river, multi-dimensionally show the most spectacular and beautiful landscape gallery along the Yangtze River, feel the unique charm of canyons, rapids and cultural relics on both banks, and convey the new charm of Yangtze River cultural tourism.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.3
programme.desc: In the third episode of our Xiamen series, we introduce four expats from BRICS countries and their inspiring lives in Xiamen. Bjorn, from South Africa, is deeply passionate about Chinese food culture and architecture, and is even skilled at oracle bone script calligraphy. Living in Shapowei, Xiamen’s busiest creative district, he knows every street and lane intimately, and has a profound love for the city's charm. Atul Verma, a yoga teacher from India, opened a yoga studio in Xiamen and built a new career here. Surrounded by Xiamen's peaceful Buddhist atmosphere, he has found a true sense of home in this foreign land. Juan Guimaraes, from Brazil, is an international freshman studying medicine at Xiamen University. Filled with curiosity and longing for both the campus and the city, he hopes to live a fulfilling life at the university and fall in love with Xiamen. Rustam Apushev, from Russia, is known to everyone as a loving “super dad”, but his true identity is a former boxing champion with countless championship medals. He met his wife in Xiamen, raised two children, founded his own school, and started a whole new life. “Xiamen is my home,” he says."

programme.title: Aerial China: Beijing
programme.desc: China’s capital of Beijing is a bucket list city for any self-styled world traveler, but let’s be honest, not all of us have the time! Not to worry, because we’re about to embark on an aerial journey over the nation’s heart, giving you a crash course on this massive hub of culture, international exchange, and technological innovation. If you’re afraid of heights, this may be the one time it’s okay to look down!

programme.title: Stitching heritage into the digital future
programme.desc: What if centuries-old craftsmanship could be re-imagined through the lens of new technology? Artist He Wei is doing just that – bringing traditional Chinese embroidery into the digital age through an immersive VR experience. Find out how he preserves cultural heritage and reinterprets folk rituals for a global audience.

programme.title: Inner Mongolia’s Frozen Wonderland
programme.desc: In this episode, we feature the Winter Nadam Fair and winter sports in Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia. By late December, the Hulunbuir Grassland is blanketed in ice and snow. Even in the bitter cold of around 30 degrees below zero, the grassland is alive with a festive bustle.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates. Along the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training hard for the arena. Together, their stories reveal Shaolin kung fu’s enduring pull, one that crosses cultures and borders while uniting practitioners through tradition, discipline, and self-mastery.

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chaozhou
programme.desc: In this episode, hosts Tianran He and Angela Fu are in Chaozhou, South China. They're on a quest to discover the secrets of its success, for Chaozhou is famed for its wealthy merchant guilds and its homegrown Teochew cuisine, which enjoys global recognition. From working as part-timers in a beef hotpot restaurant, to learning about tea ceremony and shadowing a master of Teochew cuisine, our hosts discover the best way to learn about Chaozhou, is through its food.

programme.title: Chengdu Lacquerware Art
programme.desc: Chengdu lacquerware is unique, thanks to its “three carvings and one engraving” technique. Along with its bold decorative style, this has made it a gem of Chinese lacquer art. Chengdu lacquerware also emphasizes the use of vibrant colors. Pieces are brought to beautiful life by bright red, vivid yellow, emerald green, and other striking hues.

programme.title: A talk with Li Kehua: Translating Chinese heritage through dance
programme.desc: In an era where dance converges with digital art and ancient myths find new life through motion capture, Li Kehua stands at the intersection of tradition and innovation. In this interview, she reflected on cross-cultural collaborations, the thrill of uncovering traditional crafts, and why she views herself not as a star, but as a humble stepping stone – helping audiences cross into a new world.

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people’s most important rituals: the coming?of?age ceremony.

programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special “reunion dinner” on the eve of the Torch Festival—just like their own New Year's Eve feast. Together with the locals, we celebrate their most magnificent festival: the Torch Festival.

programme.title: China Bound：Xiamen
programme.desc: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous "island of music" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in "soy sauce water". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China : Shanghai
programme.desc: Balancing delicately on an alluvial plain and the Yangtze estuary of China’s east coast, much of Shanghai-literally meaning “on the sea”-sits at an average sea-level elevation of about 4 meters. Bisecting the city is the Huangpu River, dividing it into Puxi (west bank) and Pudong (east bank), where you’ll find its famous international airport. Join us as on an aerial cruise as we journey upstream towards one of the world’s most recognizable skylines.

programme.title: A talk with Li Kehua: Translating Chinese heritage through dance
programme.desc: In an era where dance converges with digital art and ancient myths find new life through motion capture, Li Kehua stands at the intersection of tradition and innovation. In this interview, she reflected on cross-cultural collaborations, the thrill of uncovering traditional crafts, and why she views herself not as a star, but as a humble stepping stone – helping audiences cross into a new world.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious?figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Quién Eres
programme.desc: Una búsqueda de identidad desata secretos ocultos y pone en duda todo lo que parecía real.

programme.title: 23 F
programme.desc: El fallido golpe de Estado del 23 de febrero de 1981, que comenzo con la toma del parlamento español y termino con la liberacion de los parlamentarios, puso en grave riesgo la democracia española. Mientras Tejero y sus hombres mantenian a los miembros del parlamento como rehenes, el Rey, desde su despacho, intentaba contener a las fuerzas armadas y organizar a los civiles.

programme.title: La travesía
programme.desc: Cinco migrantes centroamericanos enfrentan las más duras pruebas para alcanzar el sueño americano.

programme.title: Papita, maní y tostón
programme.desc: Los fanaticos del beisbol, Andres y Julissa, se enamoran y tienen que mantener en secreto el amor de Andres por un equipo rival del padre de Julissa.

programme.title: Cacería de Asesinos
programme.desc: Consumido por el dolor y la rabia por el asesinato de su hijo, decide emprender una búsqueda implacable de justicia por su cuenta, enfrentándose a los responsables de la tragedia.

programme.title: Cuatro de Copas
programme.desc: Tres amigos, que después de una noche de alcohol no recuerdan nada de la noche anterior.

programme.title: Nubes de Cartón
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su madre, Miguel es un sin hogar, aislado de la sociedad.

programme.title: Guatemala 1982
programme.desc: Adrián Morales va a Jutiapa para recolectar las tarjetas de identificación de armas, entregadas por un amigo de su padre, el Coronel Fuentes. Equivocadamente identificado como miembro de la guerrilla, es retenido cautivo en la ciudad.

programme.desc: Adrián Morales va a Jutiapa para recolectar las tarjetas de identificación de armas, entregadas por un amigo de su padre, el Coronel Fuentes. Equivocadamente identificado como miembro de la guerrilla, es retenido cautivo en la ciudad.

programme.title: Cacería de Asesinos
programme.desc: Consumido por el dolor y la rabia por el asesinato de su hijo, decide emprender una búsqueda implacable de justicia por su cuenta, enfrentándose a los responsables de la tragedia.

programme.title: Cuatro de Copas
programme.desc: Tres amigos, que después de una noche de alcohol no recuerdan nada de la noche anterior.

programme.title: Hydra
programme.desc: Un ex marine ha sido secuestrado junto a tres convictos, llevado a una isla desierta y obligado a participar en un juego mortal. Los superricos pagan una fortuna por cazar presas humanas. Pero la isla no está desierta: es el hogar de Hydra la Bestia.

programme.title: Dracula The Original Living Vampire V2
programme.desc: La detective Amelia Van Helsing busca al asesino responsable de una serie de espantosos asesinatos de mujeres jóvenes. Las cosas empeoran cuando todas las pruebas apuntan al aparentemente intocable Conde Drácula.

programme.title: Ataque en el Aire
programme.desc: Unos agentes rusos secuestran un avión comercial estadounidense y planean estrellarlo contra una central nuclear cerca de Washington D.C., lo que provocará una lluvia radiactiva que devastará la costa este. Con poco tiempo para que los cazas de la Fuerza Aérea lo derriben, los pasajeros y la tripulación del avión deben confiar en su propia formación militar y civil para detener a los terroristas antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Vacaciones en el Infierno
programme.desc: Detenido y encarcelado en una prisión mexicana por tráfico de drogas, un hombre aprende a sobrevivir en este entorno hostil con la ayuda de un niño de 9 años.

programme.title: Tormenta nuclear
programme.desc: Las alarmas se disparan en una central nuclear, que para colmo, se ve afectada por una tormenta de gran intensidad. Los encargados deberán hacer frente a esta situación para evitar una catástrofe.

programme.title: Cut off (esp)
programme.desc: El policía forense Paul Herzfeld encuentra dentro de la cabeza de un cuerpo mutilado una cápsula que contiene un número de teléfono y el nombre de su hija.

programme.title: La Noche nunca Duerme
programme.desc: En el transcurso de una sola noche, el sargento de Crímenes Callejeros de Nueva York Thomas Cavanaugh (Dan Brennan) y sus compañeros Rourke (Stephanie Finochio) y Jablonsky (Robert Clohessy) persiguen a los asesinos de uno de los miembros de su grupo de trabajo, buscando información entre los sórdidos habitantes de un barrio infestado de delincuencia.

programme.title: American Yakuza
programme.desc: Un agente americano del FBI es atraído por la mafia japonesa -la Yakuza- en esta película de acción.

programme.title: Cambio mortal
programme.desc: David Terran, un brillante científico, ha perdido su credibilidad a causa de sus teorías apocalípticas. Las explosiones nucleares en Irán tendrán graves repercusiones y la comunidad científica tendrá que confiar en David.

programme.title: El mundo del triasico
programme.desc: Los científicos consiguen dar vida a los dinosaurios para extraer sus órganos y salvar a los humanos. Pero cuando las criaturas escapan, los científicos tienen que luchar por sus vidas.

programme.title: El asesino de al lado
programme.desc: El arquitecto Jonathan se muda a un complejo de apartamentos con patio de Los Ángeles, entonces uno de sus vecinos es asesinado por error.. Jonathan era la víctima prevista.

programme.title: San Andreas Mega Seísmo
programme.desc: Los científicos hacen un horrible descubrimiento: El "Big One" se acerca en dos días, con él, California se hundirá en el océano. Su única esperanza es romper un volcán que desplace la energía del terremoto y construya una nueva corteza en la superficie. Pero a medida que las pretemblores convierten California en un caos, se trata de una carrera contrarreloj que los científicos podrían no ganar

programme.title: Love bite
programme.desc: La escuela ha terminado y el verano llega a la ciudad costera de Rainmouth. Jamie, un chico de 18 años, deberá empezar a trabajar en el negocio familiar junto a su madre. Aburrido y agobiado, Jamie fantasea con escapar de allí hasta que de repente aparece en el pueblo Juliana, una guapa, inteligente y sexy viajante americana de la que se enamora inmediatamente. Pero hay un recién llegado más siniestro en la ciudad: un hombre lobo se alimenta de vírgenes, y Rainmouth se convierte en un coto de caza.

programme.title: 12 Catástrofes
programme.desc: El día que Jacey cumple 18 años empiezan a suceder cosas extrañas: el agua se vuelve roja, tornados aparecen de la nada y punzantes lanzas de hielo caen del cielo. Pronto se da cuenta que ella es la única que tiene el poder de detener la fatalidad inminente. Usando un antiguo libro de profecías mayas y con la ayuda de su padre, Jacey buscará la manera de frenar los doce desastres que han activado la cuenta atrás para el fin del mundo.

programme.title: Experimento Filadelfia
programme.desc: El intento por recrear un antiguo experimento secreto del gobierno fracasa y provoca un agujero espaciotemporal que hace que reaparezca el USS Eldridge, un acorazado de la Segunda Guerra Mundial que desapareció hace más de 70 años. Solo el único superviviente de la nave, acompañado por su nieta, una brillante científica, podrá detener la embarcación antes de que destroce el planeta.

programme.title: Swim
programme.desc: Une famille est prise au piège alors que la maison de vacances qu'elle loue est inondée par la pluie et qu'un requin agressif a réussi à s'y introduire.

programme.title: Desert Strike
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire au passé mystérieux conduit un groupe de réfugiés égyptiens à travers le désert et doit les protéger d'un groupe de mercenaires diaboliques.

programme.title: Mega Piranha
programme.desc: Une souche mutante de piranhas géants et féroces s'échappe de l'Amazonie et se dirige vers la Floride.

programme.title: Dragon Warriors
programme.desc: Un sorcier maléfique, Lord Tensley, cherche à obtenir la main et le cœur de la belle princesse, Lady Ennogard. Lorsqu'elle refuse, il l'enferme et libère un dragon mortel, qu'il contrôle, pour terroriser le pays. Il jure que, tant qu'elle n'aura pas accepté son amour, son dragon détruira tous ceux qui oseront montrer le moindre signe d'amour dans le royaume.

programme.title: Vampire Killers
programme.desc: Leurs femmes ayant été réduites en esclavage par la meute locale de vampires lesbiennes à cause d'une ancienne malédiction, les hommes restants d'un village rural envoient deux jeunes garçons malheureux dans les landes pour les sacrifier.

programme.title: Triple Action
programme.desc: Une mercenaire sexy et mortelle s'attaque à un syndicat international de trafiquants d'armes dirigé par la mafia russe.

programme.title: The eXtremists
programme.desc: Une équipe de tournage se rend dans les Alpes autrichiennes, près de l’ancienne frontière yougoslave, pour filmer trois passionnés de sports extrêmes poursuivis par une avalanche pour une publicité. Ce qu’ils ignorent, c’est qu’ils tournent à proximité de la cachette secrète de Slobodan Pavle, un criminel de guerre serbe. L’ayant accidentellement filmé, ils se retrouvent entraînés dans une course-poursuite mortelle à travers les montagnes, mêlant ski, snowboard, parachutisme, rafting, hélicoptères, motos et base jump.

programme.title: Yeti : Terreur en Montagne
programme.desc: Des amis partent à l'aventure dans la neige et tombent nez à nez avec une créature mortelle.

programme.title: Funeral Killers
programme.desc: Un jeu du chat et de la souris se déroule au cours d'une seule nuit, lorsque trois criminels armés font irruption dans une morgue et exigent que le médecin légiste et son assistant leur remettent une balle logée dans un cadavre. Alors que les criminels tentent désespérément de cacher leur véritable identité, le médecin se retrouve de plus en plus enlisé dans un bourbier, son passé le rattrapant malgré lui. Chaque rebondissement explosif pousse bientôt les personnages au-delà de leurs limites.

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l’établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l’aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l’alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l’empire criminel d’Ik-ho.

programme.title: King Rising 3
programme.desc: Dominic Purcell se transforme d’un tueur à gages moderne en guerrier médiéval dans cette aventure pleine d’action inspirée de la série de jeux vidéo Dungeon Siege. Découvrez des effets spéciaux époustouflants qui donnent vie à une action ininterrompue. Un tueur à gages est transporté au Moyen Âge, où il doit affronter une armée gigantesque – et un dragon cracheur de feu – dans une bataille acharnée pour survivre !

programme.title: American Ninja 5
programme.desc: Lorsque la fille d'un scientifique est kidnappée, American Ninja (David Bradley) tente de la retrouver, mais cette fois-ci, il fait équipe avec un jeune qu'il a formé aux techniques du ninja.

programme.title: L'Attaque des Drones
programme.desc: L'invasion a eu lieu, les vaisseaux absorbant les ressources de la Terre, tandis que des drones patrouillent les villes en ruines pour éliminer la moindre menace. Un réseau de survivants s'organisent pour mettre à terre le vaisseau-mère.

programme.title: Opération Cobra
programme.desc: Un agent d'Interpol se rend en Inde pour retrouver le terroriste qui a tué son partenaire.

programme.title: Force of Execution
programme.desc: Un patron du crime envoie son meilleur homme pour tuer un prisonnier. Il se trompe d'homme et en paie le prix. 6 mois plus tard, il est de nouveau sur pied. Son ex-patron se fait maintenant évincer par Ice Man, qui est responsable de l'affaire de la "mauvaise personne".

programme.title: Golia Alla Conquista Di Bagdad
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte, battaglie e colpi di scena, Golia affronta nemici e tradimenti per salvare Baghdad e difendere il regno. Diretto da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: La Rivolta Dei Mercenari
programme.desc: In un territorio sconvolto dalla ribellione, un gruppo di spietati mercenari viene ingaggiato per reprimere una rivolta, ma tradimenti e ambizioni personali accendono una lotta feroce per il potere.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP25 - Escape a la ponderosa
programme.desc: Tres desertores escaparon de una empalizada del Ejército a la Ponderosa. Cuando un capitán viene a buscarlos, Ben se da cuenta de lo que han tenido que aguantar y promete contarle la verdad a su buen amigo que está al mando de ese fuerte.

programme.title: Yellow Rock
programme.desc: Cinco hombres cabalgan hacia el inquietante pueblo de Yellow Rock, con la esperanza de rescatar a un familiar y a su hijo perdido.

programme.title: L'arciere Nero
programme.desc: Nel cuore del Medioevo, un abile arciere combatte contro tirannia e ingiustizie, guidando la ribellione del popolo tra agguati, duelli e intrighi di corte. Tra eroismo e vendetta, la sua lotta diventa simbolo di libertà.

programme.title: UN AMENAZA EN LA SOMBRA
programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de su madre, un cazarrecompensas de armas tomar encuentra al padre que nunca conoció, que está librando una guerra en la pradera contra un poderoso barón de la tierra.

programme.title: Samoa, Regina Della Giungla
programme.desc: Diretto da Guido Malatesta, con Edwige Fenech.Tra giungle inesplorate e pericoli nascosti, una coraggiosa regina guida il suo popolo contro invasori e tradimenti, tra azione e avventura.

programme.title: Los Dias de la Ira
programme.desc: Un desaliñado chico de la basura se convierte en el pupilo de un famoso pistolero, y el escenario para el enfrentamiento se prepara cuando el pistolero invade el pueblo del chico mediante la violencia y la corrupción.

programme.title: La Regina Delle Amazzoni
programme.desc: Con Gianna Maria Canale, in un regno di guerriere leggendarie, intrighi e battaglie accendono la lotta per il potere.

programme.title: L'ira Di Achille
programme.desc: Sullo sfondo della guerra di Troia, Achille affronta battaglie e passioni travolgenti guidato dall’onore e dalla sete di vendetta.

programme.title: La mujer que atracó la diligencia
programme.desc: Esta película, una de las 12 películas del Oeste realizadas en 12 meses durante 2020, cuenta la historia real de Pearl Hart, interpretada por Lorraine Etchell, una mujer que pasa por una serie de malas relaciones con los hombres, hasta que finalmente se pasa a la vida criminal con un vagabundo europeo llamado Joe Boot (Travis Mills). Juntos deciden robar una diligencia, lo que convierte a Pearl en una de las forajidas más famosas de todos los tiempos.

programme.title: A Fistful of Lead
programme.desc: Cuatro forajidos del Oeste llevan a cabo un atraco a un banco en Bath Water, un pueblo de la fiebre del oro. Cuando el grupo sale en su persecución, las cosas empeoran, ya que los bandidos se dan cuenta de que han sido traicionados.

programme.title: Lo Sceicco Rosso
programme.desc: Nel cuore del deserto, un misterioso sceicco guida ribellioni e intrighi tra tribù rivali e poteri coloniali, tra azione e colpi di scena. Diretto da Ferdinando Cerchio.

programme.title: Buen Funeral Amigos paga Sartana
programme.desc: Cuando una joven hereda una mina de oro de su tío asesinado, Sartana acude en su ayuda mientras varios estafadores, incluido el sheriff local, intentan reclamarla como suya.

programme.title: Cyrano Contro D'artagnan
programme.desc: Tra duelli e intrighi di corte, Cyrano e D’Artagnan si affrontano e si alleano tra rivalità e onore, in un’avventura ricca di azione e spirito cavalleresco.

programme.title: Cassidy Red
programme.desc: Cuatro de los forajidos más infames del Oeste llevan a cabo un audaz robo a un banco en la ciudad minera de Bath Water. Mientras la banda es perseguida por la ley, las cosas se complican cuando los bandidos descubren que han sido traicionados, pero ¿por quién?

programme.title: Maciste All'inferno
programme.desc: Tra inferi, magie oscure e creature demoniache, Maciste affronta una sfida estrema per salvare innocenti dal male.

programme.title: Ases y Ochos
programme.desc: Los pacíficos colonos de una ciudad destinada a la grandeza del ferrocarril se arriesgan a establecerse en el inexplorado Oeste y, de repente, son asesinados a tiros sin piedad. Sin ley ni orden, la justicia recae sobre los hombros de un anciano ranchero y un pistolero consumado pero retirado.

programme.title: Maciste Contro I Cacciatori Di Teste
programme.desc: In terre selvagge e misteriose, Maciste sfida tribù feroci e pericoli mortali per salvare innocenti e ristabilire la pace.

programme.title: Los McMasters
programme.desc: Cuando un veterano negro de la Guerra Civil se convierte en copropietario del rancho sureño de los McMasters, los indignados veteranos confederados locales vienen a por él y su esposa india.

programme.title: I Coltelli Del Vendicatore
programme.desc: Tra intrighi e vendetta in un’ambientazione nordica, un uomo combatte contro tradimenti e usurpatori per ristabilire giustizia, tra duelli e colpi di scena. Diretto da Mario Bava e Leopoldo Savona.

programme.title: Una pistola para cien cruces
programme.desc: Un irlandés es asesinado en el salvaje Oeste. Su hijo Jimmy sale en busca de los asesinos de su padre, pero pronto cae en una emboscada de dos salteadores de caminos y es asesinado también. Django (o Sartana, según la versión de la película) lo encuentra y lee la carta que Jimmy había recibido de su hermana Jessica Dublin contándole el asesinato de su padre.

programme.title: Genoveffa Di Brabante - La Lancia Della Vendetta
programme.desc: Accusata ingiustamente di tradimento, Genoveffa viene esiliata e costretta a sopravvivere nei boschi con il figlio, affrontando fame e pericoli mentre la verità cerca di emergere.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: Durante el fragor de la batalla en plena Guerra Civil, nace un potro seductoramente inocente de la querida yegua del soldado Jim Rabb. Rechazando la orden de matarlo para que no se convierta en un estorbo, Rabb se queda con el potro como consuelo en estos tiempos desesperados, un símbolo de esperanza que lleva a los hombres del Primer Arma de Caballería a un viaje de autodescubrimiento y nueva hermandad.

programme.title: Il Terrore Dei Barbari
programme.desc: Tra invasioni, assedi e battaglie spettacolari, un eroe affronta orde barbariche per difendere il destino di Roma.

programme.title: El Valor de un Corbade
programme.desc: La banda de los Blackie lleva a cabo el atraco perfecto a un banco. Pero, ¿quién se llevó el dinero?

programme.title: Il Magnifico Gladiatore
programme.desc: Diretto da Alfonso Brescia con Mark Forest, un gladiatore affronta tiranni e tradimenti in una Roma dominata dal potere.

programme.title: El Hombre el orgullo y la venganza
programme.desc: Un incondicional soldado español recurre a la delincuencia para demostrar su amor por una misteriosa y promiscua gitana.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Avventuriero
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte e imprese eroiche, un audace avventuriero affronta duelli e complotti in un viaggio ricco di azione e colpi di scena.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP19 - Los asesinos a sueldo
programme.desc: Hoss y Little Joe son confundidos con sanguinarios asesinos a sueldo en un pequeño pueblo de Texas dominado por dos familias enemistadas.

programme.title: Robin, Frecce, Fagioli E Karate
programme.desc: Un improbabile eroe si ritrova coinvolto in combattimenti e situazioni esilaranti tra azione e comicità. Diretto da Tonino Ricci.

programme.title: Death Alley
programme.desc: En 1892, la banda de los Dalton se propuso convertirse en los forajidos más famosos de Estados Unidos. Este sueño se convirtió en pesadilla.

programme.title: Je vais... je tire... et je reviens
programme.desc: Un gang dérobe une cargaison d'or dans un train. Un soi-disant chasseur de primes est envoyé à la recherche des voleurs et décide de les laisser le conduire jusqu'à l'or.

programme.title: Texas
programme.desc: A Dallas, un ancien soldat de l'Union tente de démasquer une conspiration de Sudistes qui ont assassiné son père, son ami et le Président.

programme.title: Un homme, un cheval et un pistolet
programme.desc: Un pistolero cynique, aidé par un vieux prophète, se retrouve mêlé à une querelle avec une bande de bandits qui tentent de s'emparer d'une diligence en or massif.

programme.title: Route mystérieuse
programme.desc: Un détective aborigène retourne dans l'Outback australien pour enquêter sur le meurtre d'une jeune fille.

programme.title: Un dollar entre les dents
programme.desc: Un pistolero solitaire tente de conclure un marché avec un bandit mexicain pour se partager un chargement d'or volé, ce qui donne lieu à un jeu de trahisons sans merci entre les deux hommes.

programme.title: Un bounty killer à Trinita
programme.desc: Les habitants de Trinity décident d'engager un chasseur de primes notoire pour les protéger d'une bande de hors-la-loi mexicains qui sème la terreur dans la région. Il découvre que le véritable instigateur de ces bandits se cache en ville. Une fusillade sanglante met fin à l'emprise de la bande et rend le contrôle de la ville à ses habitants.

programme.title: Furie au Missouri
programme.desc: Pendant les derniers mois de la guerre de Sécession, le frère de Joe est injustement tué par Clifford, un capitaine de l'armée nordiste. Joe décide de rejoindre un groupe de Sudistes déterminés à résister jusqu'au bout.

programme.title: Black Killer
programme.desc: À Tombstone, un nouveau shérif s'engage à débarrasser la ville des hors-la-loi tels que les frères O'Hara, avec l'aide d'un étrange avocat qui se promène toujours avec deux gros ouvrages de droit sous le bras.

programme.title: Adios Gringo
programme.desc: Un cow-boy tente de laver son nom en chassant les voleurs de bétail qui l'ont piégé en lui faisant acheter du bétail volé et qui sont également responsables du viol d'une jeune femme qu'il aide à se rétablir.

programme.title: Garringo
programme.desc: Quand il était petit, Johnny a vu son père tué par des soldats. Des années plus tard, il est devenu un hors-la-loi et tue des soldats chaque fois qu'il le peut. Le lieutenant Garringo (Steffen) est envoyé pour arrêter Johnny (Lawrence) et le ramener vivant.

programme.title: Le pistolero de Tombstone
programme.desc: Un homme est faussement accusé de vol de banque, ce qui pousse son frère à le faire sortir de prison. Ensemble, ils partent à la recherche des vrais coupables et leur quête les mène à une bande de hors-la-loi dirigée par un célèbre bandit armé.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: On m'appelle King
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes traque une bande de trafiquants d'armes à travers la frontière mexicaine.

programme.title: Les Femmes de Jesse James
programme.desc: Jesse James est tellement occupé à courir les jupons que sa carrière de hors-la-loi commence à en pâtir.

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé
programme.desc: Une célèbre ballerine viennoise fuit l'Europe pendant la guerre austro-prussienne et tombe amoureuse d'un bandit américain qui ressemble à son défunt amant royal.

programme.title: Le Rocher du Diable
programme.desc: Deux vieux amis se retrouvent dans des camps opposés pendant la guerre civile lors d'une bataille désespérée au sommet d'une montagne imprenable.

programme.title: Les couleurs du désert
programme.desc: Deux hommes trouvent un bébé abandonné et se disputent la propriété de l'enfant, ce qui entraîne une rivalité à vie.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24, Estilo
programme.desc: Tendencias, cultura y viajes con Gabriel Vélez y Santiago Padilla, una mirada fresca y actual.

programme.title: Sexo, Amor y Cachondeo
programme.desc: Un espacio sobre parejas desde tres ángulos: sexual, amoroso y cachondo, para enamorar, seducir y reír.

programme.title: Cocinísima

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Alexander the Great…Cleopatra, Queen of Egypt…Vlad III Dracul, Prince of Romania…the legacy of these historical icons live on in our modern day culture, but the mysterious circumstances that surround their deaths and conflicting reports of their final resting places have inspired worldwide investigation and unleashed a furious hunt to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Ancient architecture stands as a lasting testimony to human achievement, a visual reflection of the cultural needs and shifting beliefs of civilizations at different points in time. Archeologists avidly study the ancient architecture of the past – temples, buildings and monuments – to reveal clues about the ancient civilizations that created them and understand how past innovation has helped shape the construction of our modern-day world.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: The unexplained appearance of geometric shapes in various locations around the face of the Earth has baffled archaeologists, scientists and researchers alike. These puzzling designs form mysterious figures and alignments that suggest an important purpose, but leave behind more questions than answers, a riddle of origin that buries scholars under mountains of speculative theory and drives their search for scientific proof.

programme.title: Pharm to Table
programme.desc: How far would you go, to know what's in your food? As we go about our daily lives, few of us stop to wonder what our food is really made of. Taylor Lancastor travels 2800 miles on foot, to defend our right to know, and discover the truth of what we are being fed.

programme.title: Africa: The Serengeti
programme.desc: Chronicles a spectacle that few humans have ever witnessed, the Great Migration, taking viewers on a journey with over 1.5 million animals as they travel more than 500 miles across the Serengeti plains in Tanzania and Kenya.

programme.title: Anaconda - The Silent Killer
programme.desc: Few snakes are feared more and understood less than the anaconda. The film shows the journey into remote and uncharted parts of the Amazon rainforest to find the truth behind the mythical beast. Lush green forests abound with colorful toucans, noisy howler monkeys, strange tapirs, and vibrant Amazon Indian tribes. But hiding in the dense vegetation and murky swamps is also the biggest and most powerful snake in the world: the anaconda.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Observing two massive elk clashing their antlers is to witness a true demonstration of power. For other species, such as the European marmot, remaining in power is a matter of collaborating with family and community. Are these animals forced to give up their hard-won social status as they age? Through this lens, we take a deep and entertaining look at the challenges faced by those in power ... and what it takes to stay there.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: In many human cultures, elders play a vital role in the well-being of communities and are responsible for passing down knowledge and culture. Is it any wonder to find that the orca, the elephant, and the wolf, have been found to transmit their respective cultures to the younger generations? Young animals learn by observing their elders. Judging when to fight or take flight, deciding how to choose a life partner, learning where to find food, these are just some of the skills passed down through the generations as elders share their wisdom.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer. This raises questions about what is no doubt a sensitive subject, one that brings to mind our own mortality as we speculate about the reasons for this kind of resilience in our animal counterparts. What lessons can we learn from the animal kingdom? We follow individuals to their last breath ... not as voyeurs, but as spectators attuned to the circle of life.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: It is easy to overlook the tiny in stature, but sometimes the smallest should be the most feared. On this episode of Killer Instinct, three big little assassins prove that size has nothing to do with survival.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Apex predators sit comfortably atop the food chain. Cunning as they are large, they rule over their environments. Large and in-charge, their speed and bulk deliver a knockout blow.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Venom, a lethal weapon brandished by hundreds of animals of all shapes and sizes, over land and sea. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we’ll meet three creatures whose venomous sting strikes fear in the hearts of people around the globe.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Nature’s heavyweight battles test the most powerful animals’ killer instincts and their will to live. On this episode, we explore what happens when the world’s most deadly apex predators go head to head for survival!

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Nature’s heavyweight battles test the most powerful animals’ killer instincts and their will to live. On this episode, we explore what happens when the world’s most deadly apex predators go head to head for survival!

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Few things in nature conjure such instant fear as a set of killer teeth rising out of gaping jaws. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we’ll examine a number of sharp toothed animals worthy of a much closer look.

programme.title: Last Devils
programme.desc: Tasmanian Devils are the world's largest carnivorous marsupials and they are only found in Tasmania. Through hundreds of hours of filming in the wild, we reveal how fights over food are a carefully choreographed ritual, we witness the seemingly brutal mating process, see tiny young developing inside their mother's pouch, and visit wild devil pups play-fighting and hunting as they prepare for life in the outside world.

programme.title: African Nostalgia
programme.desc: Africa seen and described through the eyes of a wildlife photographer who has always been fascinated by the unique atmosphere of this extraordinary continent.

programme.title: Quolls: Fast and Furious
programme.desc: A marsupial native cat has stalked the mountain tops of its northern domain for thousands of years. In the lush tropical rainforests of northern Queensland, the largest surviving marsupial carnivore on mainland Australia has remained isolated and hidden from sight… until now!

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Australia's renowned deadly serpents include the inland taipan, the most toxic serpent in the world, and the enormous king brown, which can deliver more venom in a single bite than any other snake. As Nigel counts down his top ten, he's helped by Steve Irwin's son Robert, whose favourite billabong is a prime spot for a snake on Nigel's list.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Every year over a million people are bitten by snakes, resulting in some 46,000 deaths - Nigel tracks down the ten deadliest. He meets an enormous king cobra and the infamous Russell's viper, a snake responsible for more deaths than any other. With the help of the Irula, a tribe of snake hunters, he faces off with kraits, vipers and cobras.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Europe is home to some 50 species of snakes; around 19 of them are venomous. Nigel crosses the continent in search of the most dangerous. On the Greek island of Milos there's an endangered viper that ambushes birds, while in Spain there are Montpellier snakes, asp vipers, colourful lizards and egg-laden toads. Amid ancient Turkish ruins he uncovers a massive Ottoman viper, a snake once used as a weapon of war.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Nigel comes face-to-face with the Philippine cobra, the most lethally venomous cobra on the planet. And in deep, dark caves on Palawan Island, the presenter searches for giant reticulated pythons sheltering from the heat of the day.

programme.title: Swimming with Legends
programme.desc: Shot over 2 years and in 9 different destinations, Swimming with Legends documents the life of a Belgium freediver Fred Buyle and his lasting fascination for the legends of the deep as described in ancient texts and mariner's nightmares.

programme.title: Turtle Odyssey
programme.desc: Sea turtles are some of Earth's most ancient and majestic creatures. For over 100 million years, they have traversed the seas, enduring mass extinctions and playing critical roles in maintaining food webs. But now they face a new threat – humans. It's time we learned more about these remarkable reptiles.

programme.title: Wonders of the Arctic
programme.desc: Our ongoing quest to explore and come to terms with the Arctic is presented in the context of the crucial role that ice plays in the north. Ice is to the Arctic as trees are to the rainforest.

programme.title: Sea Lions: Life by a Whisker
programme.desc: Between a jagged cliff face and a roaring ocean, lives a colony of Australian Sea Lions. In an environment equally as harsh as it is beautiful, be immersed in a classic coming of age tale guided by one of Australia's most unique, intelligent, and playful animals. Take an intimate journey inside the colony where a life of great intimacy, tenderness, and clumsiness, must often give way to a life of great sacrifice and bravery. Dive into the world of a rare Australian Sea Lion pup - and meet the people that are trying to save her species.

programme.title: Amazing Journeys
programme.desc: Experience the world's greatest animal migrations from zebras in East Africa, to millions of red crabs on Christmas Island, to gray whales in Mexico's beautiful lagoons, and monarch butterflies in the Mexican highlands. Travel back in time among exotic tribes of Africa to explore the roots of human migration.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Présumés coupables: souvenirs volés
programme.desc: Anna (Alexandra Neldel) reçoit un appel téléphonique de son nouveau partenaire commercial Philipp Rothkamm (Maximilian von Pufendorf) : Dans une université d'élite, une jeune femme (Emily Cox) affirme avoir été abusée sexuellement sous l'influence de gouttes de knock-out à une fête de la fraîcheur. Mais après un entretien personnel, ses doutes surgissent. Peu de temps après, la jeune femme se suicide.

programme.title: Meurtres au féminin
programme.desc: Eva est une jeune femme flic chargée des affaires de vols au sein de la ville de Barcelone. Un jour, elle est appelée en urgence pour rejoindre l’unité qui traque une tueuse en série ayant pour cible les vieilles femmes. Alors qu’un vent de panique s’abat sur la ville, la jeune femme pourtant novice dans ce genre d’affaires, va tenter de mettre la main sur la meurtrière… C’est sans ompter la bataille personnelle qu’elle va devoir mener de front contre son inspecteur en chef, qui passe son temps à lui fermer la porte au nez et lui compliquer la tâche au sein de l’unité.

programme.title: La Chanteuse Amoureuse
programme.desc: Une pop star frustrée par la gestion excessive de sa carrière, rêvant d’une vie ordinaire, se retrouve partagée entre son ex célèbre, les manigances de son manager autoritaire et une romance naissante avec un propriétaire de disquaire terre-à-terre.

programme.title: Basket
programme.desc: Une communauté pittoresque du nord-ouest du Pacifique élevant son blé et ses enfants au milieu d'une nation ébranlée par la Première Guerre mondiale est à l'origine de The Basket. À une époque de douleur et de préjugés tissés sur fond de beauté, The Basket évoque finalement le triomphe et l'espoir dans une Amérique en pleine mutation.

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam et Tusker voyagent à travers l'Angleterre dans leur vieux camping-car pour voir leurs amis, leur famille et des lieux du passé. Depuis le diagnostic de démence de Tusker, leur temps ensemble le plus précieux de tous.

programme.title: Une Mère Diabolique
programme.desc: Lorsque Allison, 14 ans, perd son père dans un accident d'avion, trois ans après la mort de sa mère adoptive, elle est dévastée. Lors des funérailles, elle est choquée de rencontrer sa mère biologique, Jessica. Elle et sa demi-sœur Sydni seront encore plus choquées de découvrir que Jessica a un plan infâme pour contrôler les 40 millions de dollars dont Allison doit hériter.

programme.title: Présomption d'innocence
programme.desc: Une femme est reconnue coupable d'avoir tué son petit ami et sa meilleure amie dans le feu de la passion bien qu'elle ait été défendue par un avocat de renom. Elle s'enfuit après le procès afin de découvrir qui l'a piégée.

programme.title: Amour, Romance & Chocolat
programme.desc: Emma et le chocolatier Luc concourent pour le titre de chocolatier royal de Belgique. La beauté et le romantisme de Bruges inspirent des combinaisons de chocolat uniques, mais leur projet gagnera-t-il sans qu'ils ne perdent leur cœur ?

programme.title: Never Let Go
programme.desc: Une mère célibataire en vacances fait appel à la justice pour récupérer son enfant enlevé.

programme.title: La mémoire de mon pays
programme.desc: Langston Whitfield est journaliste au Washington Post. Son rédacteur en chef l’envoie en Afrique du Sud pour couvrir les audiences de la Commission Vérité et Réconciliation, où les auteurs de meurtres et de tortures des deux camps durant l’Apartheid sont invités à se présenter et à affronter leurs victimes. En disant la vérité sans fard et en exprimant des remords, ils peuvent obtenir l’amnistie. Les profondes blessures de l’Apartheid peuvent-elles être guéries par la réconciliation ?

programme.title: L'Édition de l'Amour
programme.desc: La rédactrice beauté d’un magazine féminin convainc un photographe prometteur de prétendre être son petit ami lorsque son ex se fiance avec une autre. Ensemble, ils devront collaborer pour redorer la réputation déclinante du magazine.

programme.title: La liberté à tout prix
programme.desc: Allemagne de l'Est, 1984 : Frank Korbach se réjouit de fréquenter l'école d'art dramatique, tandis que son meilleur ami rebelle Thomas refuse de faire son service militaire. Avec l'aventureux mais naïf Alex, Thomas projette de faire une tentative désespérée de fuite vers l'Ouest. Sachant qu'il ne les reverra peut-être jamais, Frank accompagne Thomas et Alex à la frontière. Soudain, ils sont confrontés à une unité spéciale de la Stasi, la police secrète est-allemande. Bien que les garçons parviennent à éviter la capture, l'ancienne vie de Frank a disparu à jamais - il est maintenant devenu un fugitif. Le père de Frank, Kurt Korbach, est stupéfait par cette évasion. Kurt est un major de la Stasi, à l'insu de son fils. Convaincu que Frank est innocent, il persuade ses supérieurs que lui seul peut ramener son fils. Avec le suspect colonel Frey - une bombe à retardement prête à exploser - Kurt se met en route pour retrouver les garçons en fuite.

programme.title: La vie selon Gus Orviston
programme.desc: Un jeune homme abandonne sa famille pour mener une vie solitaire consacrée à la pêche à la mouche. Son objectif était de trouver sa propre voie dans le monde de la pêche et ainsi se découvrir lui-même et trouver l'amour.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: The story of a long-lost book that mysteriously reappears and connects an old man searching for his son with a girl seeking a cure for her mother's loneliness.
